_comment: Post-edit quality-check rules: file-name glob -> command ({file} is replaced with the edited file's absolute path). Language-agnostic; add or remove rules as needed. Commands that cannot run (tool not installed) are skipped silently.

rules.label: py-syntax
rules._note: Minimal check that works offline (syntax only). With ruff/mypy installed, switch to the stronger rules in quality-checks.sample.json.
